summary: A progressive 3-phase interactive learning platform for TOEIC test preparation, featuring vocabulary flashcards, paraphrase matching exercises, and logical deduction challenges using business English contexts.

frontend.App.jsx: Main orchestrator managing phase transitions (1→2→3) and rendering current learning module
frontend.FlashcardModule.jsx: Phase 1 - 3D flip cards for vocabulary acquisition with spaced repetition feedback
frontend.ParaphraseMatcher.jsx: Phase 2 - Interactive matching game for paraphrase recognition with accuracy tracking
frontend.TriangulationEngine.jsx: Phase 3 - Clue-based logical reasoning engine requiring evidence collection before question unlock
frontend.content.json: Centralized data store for scenarios, questions, options, and feedback

backend.component: No backend - fully client-side React application

dataFlow: User starts at Phase 1 (FlashcardModule) with vocabulary cards
User flips cards to reveal definitions and business contexts
User rates mastery level (Lexical Deficit/Grammar Error/Mastered)
Upon completion, onComplete callback triggers phase transition to Phase 2
User clicks source and target phrases to match equivalent meanings
Correct matches are locked; incorrect matches shake and reset
Upon 100% completion, modal displays accuracy stats and unlocks Phase 3
User clicks sentences to identify clues (non-clues trigger shake animation)
When all clues found, question section unlocks with blur removal
User selects answer and submits for validation with feedback
Correct answer enables Next Scenario button to progress

keyFiles.reason: Entry point orchestrating all 3 phases with state management for phase transitions. Start here to understand application flow.
Phase 1 implementation with 3D CSS transforms, hardcoded flashcard data, and spaced repetition UI. Modify to add new vocabulary cards.
Phase 2 matching game with shuffle logic, match verification, and completion modal. Contains hardcoded paraphrase pairs for modification.
Phase 3 logical reasoning engine consuming content.json. Core deduction mechanic with clue discovery and question unlocking.
Centralized data source for Phase 3 scenarios. Add new scenarios here without touching component code. Schema: scenarios array with text/clues/questions/options.

entryPoints.add_feature: Start in src/App.jsx to add new phases or modify phase flow. For new learning modules, create component in src/ and import into App.jsx with phase condition.
entryPoints.fix_bug: Check browser console for errors. Phase 1-2 bugs likely in respective module files. Phase 3 bugs check TriangulationEngine.jsx and content.json schema validation.
entryPoints.change_styling: Global styles in src/index.css (Tailwind base). Component-specific styles use Tailwind utility classes inline. Color scheme: #003366 (primary blue), #e78218 (accent orange).

gotchas: FlashcardModule and ParaphraseMatcher have HARDCODED data arrays - not scalable. Consider moving to JSON files like Phase 3.
Phase transitions use onComplete callbacks - no routing/navigation. Adding browser back button support requires React Router implementation.
TriangulationEngine expects specific JSON schema (isClue boolean, isCorrect boolean). Breaking schema causes runtime errors with no validation.
CSS animations (flip, shake) use custom Tailwind classes that may need postcss.config.js configuration. Check if animate-shake is defined.
No state persistence - refreshing browser resets to Phase 1. Consider localStorage or backend integration for progress tracking.
